# GitHub Copilot instructions — Canopy

Before proposing, writing, reviewing, or refactoring code in this repository, **read and follow the complete root [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)**. That is Canopy's single source of truth for coding-agent instructions; this file is only a compatibility entry point, not a separate rule set.

For desktop UI changes, also read [Design System](../docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md) and [Visual Quality Gate](../docs/VISUAL_QUALITY_GATE.md). For architecture and resource usage, read [Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and [Performance](../docs/PERFORMANCE.md).

Keep Canopy **beautiful, premium, cohesive, accessible and lightweight**. Preserve clean modular engineering, autonomous testing where supported, root-cause fixes, regression checks, verified evidence and feature-branch review. Do not declare mockups to be running Linux screenshots or performance budgets to be measurements.

If the environment cannot read linked guidance, explicitly report that and obtain the instructions before making changes. If guidance conflicts, do not silently discard requirements.
